items.name: AML Alert Identifier
items.definition: Unique identifier of an AML monitoring alert.

items.name: AML Risk Score
items.definition: Numeric AML risk score (0-100) computed by the AML engine.

items.name: AML Scenario
items.definition: Detection scenario that triggered the alert (structuring, rapid movement, high-risk country...).

items.name: Account Balance
items.definition: Ledger balance of an account at end of day, in account currency.

items.name: Account Count
items.definition: Number of accounts held by the customer.

items.name: Account Number
items.definition: Unique number identifying a customer account in the core banking system.

items.name: Account Opening Date
items.definition: Date the account was opened.

items.name: Account Status
items.definition: Lifecycle status of the account: Active, Dormant, Closed, Blocked.

items.name: Account Type
items.definition: Product category of the account: Savings, Current, Term Deposit.

items.name: Alert Age Days
items.definition: Number of days between alert creation and closure (or today if still open).

items.name: Alert Closed Date
items.definition: Date the alert investigation was closed.

items.name: Alert Created Date
items.definition: Date the alert was generated.

items.name: Alert Severity
items.definition: Priority of the alert: Low, Medium, High, Critical.

items.name: Alert Status
items.definition: Workflow status of the alert: Open, In Investigation, Closed-FP, Closed-STR.

items.name: Available Balance
items.definition: Ledger balance minus holds and blocked amounts that the customer can use.

items.name: Balance After Transaction
items.definition: Account balance immediately after the transaction was posted.

items.name: Branch Code
items.definition: Unique code of the bank branch that owns the customer or account.

items.name: Branch Deposits
items.definition: Total deposit balances held at the branch.

items.name: Branch Manager ID
items.definition: Employee identifier of the branch manager.

items.name: Branch Name
items.definition: Official name of the bank branch.

items.name: Branch Net Income
items.definition: Credits minus debits attributed to the branch in the period.

items.name: Card Count
items.definition: Number of active cards held by the customer.

items.name: Card Expiry Date
items.definition: Month and year after which the card is no longer valid.

items.name: Card Identifier
items.definition: Internal unique identifier of a payment card.

items.name: Card Issue Date
items.definition: Date the card was issued to the customer.

items.name: Card Status
items.definition: Status of the card: Active, Blocked, Expired, Cancelled.

items.name: Card Type
items.definition: Card product type: Debit, Credit, Prepaid.

items.name: Channel
items.definition: Channel through which the transaction was initiated: Branch, ATM, Mobile, Internet, POS.

items.name: City
items.definition: City where the branch is located.

items.name: Collateral Coverage Ratio
items.definition: Collateral value divided by outstanding balance of the loan.

items.name: Collateral Value
items.definition: Current market value of collateral pledged against the loan.

items.name: Cost Center
items.definition: Organizational unit to which costs and revenues are allocated.

items.name: Counterparty Account
items.definition: Account of the other party in a transfer or payment.

items.name: Credit Amount
items.definition: Total credit movement in the period for a GL account.

items.name: Credit Limit
items.definition: Maximum amount the cardholder is allowed to borrow on the card.

items.name: Currency Code
items.definition: ISO 4217 code of the currency of an amount or account.

items.name: Customer Age
items.definition: Age of the customer in completed years, derived from Date of Birth.

items.name: Customer Identifier
items.definition: Unique identifier assigned to a customer across all bank systems.

items.name: Customer Name
items.definition: Full legal name of the customer as in the national ID or commercial register.

items.name: Customer Onboarding Date
items.definition: Date the customer relationship was established.

items.name: Customer Risk Rating
items.definition: AML/CFT risk rating of the customer: Low, Medium or High.

items.name: Customer Segment
items.definition: Commercial segment of the customer: Mass, Affluent, Private, SME or Corporate.

items.name: Date of Birth
items.definition: Date on which the individual customer was born.

items.name: Days Past Due
items.definition: Number of days a loan payment is overdue.

items.name: Debit Amount
items.definition: Total debit movement in the period for a GL account.

items.name: Disbursement Date
items.definition: Date funds were released to the borrower.

items.name: Email Address
items.definition: Primary email address registered for the customer.

items.name: Expected Credit Loss
items.definition: IFRS 9 expected credit loss = PD x LGD x EAD.

items.name: Exposure at Default
items.definition: Expected exposure to the bank at the time of default.

items.name: GL Account Code
items.definition: Chart-of-accounts code of a general ledger account.

items.name: GL Closing Balance
items.definition: Closing balance of the GL account for the period.

items.name: Gender
items.definition: Gender of the individual customer (M/F).

items.name: IBAN
items.definition: International Bank Account Number of the account.

items.name: IFRS9 Stage
items.definition: IFRS 9 impairment stage of the loan: 1 (performing), 2 (under-performing), 3 (credit-impaired).

items.name: Interest Rate
items.definition: Annual nominal interest rate applied to an account or loan.

items.name: KYC Last Review Date
items.definition: Date of the last periodic KYC review.

items.name: KYC Next Review Date
items.definition: Date the next periodic KYC review is due, based on risk rating.

items.name: KYC Profile Identifier
items.definition: Unique identifier of the KYC profile record.

items.name: KYC Status
items.definition: Current state of the customer's Know-Your-Customer file: Complete, Incomplete or Expired.

items.name: Last Transaction Date
items.definition: Date of the latest customer-initiated transaction on the account.

items.name: Loan Identifier
items.definition: Unique identifier of a loan facility.

items.name: Loan Tenor
items.definition: Contractual loan duration in months.

items.name: Loss Given Default
items.definition: Share of exposure expected to be lost if the borrower defaults.

items.name: Mobile Number
items.definition: Primary mobile phone number registered for the customer.

items.name: NPL Flag
items.definition: Indicator that the loan is non-performing (Days Past Due above 90).

items.name: National ID Number
items.definition: 14-digit Egyptian national identification number of an individual customer.

items.name: Nationality
items.definition: Nationality of the customer (ISO 3166 alpha-3).

items.name: Occupation
items.definition: Declared occupation or profession of the individual customer.

items.name: Outstanding Balance
items.definition: Remaining principal plus accrued interest owed on the loan.

items.name: PEP Flag
items.definition: Indicator that the customer is a Politically Exposed Person.

items.name: Primary Account Number
items.definition: Card number (PAN) printed on a payment card; subject to PCI-DSS.

items.name: Principal Amount
items.definition: Original approved and disbursed amount of the loan.

items.name: Probability of Default
items.definition: Estimated probability that the borrower defaults within 12 months.

items.name: Product Code
items.definition: Code of the banking product (loan, card or deposit product).

items.name: Region
items.definition: Geographic region the branch belongs to (Cairo, Delta, Upper Egypt, Canal...).

items.name: Reporting Period
items.definition: Financial period (YYYYMM) of a ledger balance.

items.name: Sanction Screening Result
items.definition: Outcome of screening the customer against sanctions lists: Clear, Potential Match, Confirmed.

items.name: Source of Funds
items.definition: Declared origin of the customer's funds.

items.name: Total Customer Balance
items.definition: Sum of balances of all accounts owned by a customer.

items.name: Total Loan Outstanding
items.definition: Sum of outstanding balances of all customer loans.

items.name: Transaction Amount
items.definition: Amount of the transaction in transaction currency.

items.name: Transaction Count
items.definition: Number of transactions in the period.

items.name: Transaction Date
items.definition: Value date on which the transaction was posted.

items.name: Transaction Identifier
items.definition: Unique reference of a posted financial transaction.

items.name: Transaction Narration
items.definition: Free-text description of the transaction.

items.name: Transaction Type
items.definition: Type of transaction: Deposit, Withdrawal, Transfer, Payment, Fee.

items.name: Transaction Volume
items.definition: Total value of transactions in the period.
